jobs.details: Vacancy Notice: Secretary (Admin Section - Local Agent, Group 3) EEAS - European External Action Service Cairo National Local Agent Group 3 level Speaks Arabic, English Apply Summary by Impactpool The EU Delegation to Egypt is seeking a Secretary (Local Agent Group 3) for a fixed-term contract of 2 years, with potential for renewal. The role involves providing administrative support in areas such as accounting, logistics, and human resource management. The successful candidate will assist in staff recruitment, payroll preparation, office management, and procurement procedures. This position requires excellent communication skills in English and Arabic, along with strong computer proficiency. Candidate Requirements: High School Degree or equivalent Minimum 3 years of experience as Secretary C2 level English and Arabic proficiency Excellent computer skills Right to residence and work in Egypt Contract type: Local Agent Who we are The European Union (EU) is an economic and political partnership between 27 European countries. It plays an important role in international affairs through diplomacy, trade, development aid and working with global organizations. Abroad, the European Union is represented through more than 140 diplomatic representations, known also as EU Delegations, which have a similar function to those of an embassy. The EU Delegation to the Arab Republic of Egypt, Cairo works in close coordination with the Embassies and Consulates of the 27 EU Member States. We are a fully-fledged diplomatic mission and represent the European Union in dealings with the Egyptian government in areas that are part of the EU’s remit.
